changes: Retain underline mobile entry tabs with a lighter 2px red active indicator and a 44px minimum target.
Share the inventory's plain 20px arrow across Home, Inventory and Import cards; keep the whole card interactive.
Remove vehicle spec badge icons, use consistent 14px text and spacing, and retain full accessible spec values.
Order inventory controls as Search, Sort, Filter in both the DOM and the rendered row.
Use the same muted placeholder colour for Home, Sell and Import entry fields.
Label import examples with sample countries/regions, retain one small example disclosure, and carry the selected sample origin into the editable request.
Keep badge and price text on one line; use roomier card layouts for enlarged text and constrain Home hero grid tracks.
